cyber.css: .th-cyber{--pzbg:#120a18}.th-cyber .pz-pnl{background:rgba(12,6,16,.95);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #ff2e88;clip-path:polygon(12px 0,100% 0,100% calc(100% - 12px),calc(100% - 12px) 100%,0 100%,0 12px)}.th-cyber .pz-bn{animation:pzg 1.4s steps(1) infinite}@keyframes pzg{0%,100%{transform:none}92%{transform:translateX(-3px)}94%{transform:translateX(2px)}}.th-cyber .pz-bn b,.th-cyber .pz-toast b,.th-cyber .pz-pc>b{letter-spacing:.1em}.th-cyber .pz-btns span{clip-path:polygon(8px 0,100% 0,100% calc(100% - 8px),calc(100% - 8px) 100%,0 100%,0 8px);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}.th-cyber .pz-sheet{clip-path:none;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #ff2e88}.th-cyber .pz-ring{border-radius:0;clip-path:polygon(20% 0,100% 0,100% 80%,80% 100%,0 100%,0 20%)}.th-cyber .pz-ring::before{border-radius:0}

pixel.css: .th-pixel{--pzbg:#1a1220}.th-pixel .pz-pnl{background:#22182a;border:6px solid transparent;border-image:url(/tp/img/px-frame.png) 3 fill / 6px;image-rendering:pixelated;box-shadow:none;border-radius:0}.th-pixel .pz-bn b,.th-pixel .pz-toast b,.th-pixel .pz-pc>b,.th-pixel .pz-sheet .hd b{font:700 15px Silkscreen;color:#ffe08a}.th-pixel .pz-pc>b{font-size:22px}.th-pixel .pz-toast small.k{font:400 10px Silkscreen}.th-pixel .pz-dots i{border-radius:0;animation-timing-function:steps(2)}.th-pixel .pz-ring{border-radius:0;animation:none}.th-pixel .pz-ring::before{border-radius:0}.th-pixel .pz-btns span{border-radius:0;font:400 12px Silkscreen}.th-pixel .pz-row2,.th-pixel .pz-opts div{border-radius:0}.th-pixel .pz-row2 i,.th-pixel .pz-row2 i::after{border-radius:0}

train.css: .th-train{--pzbg:#0a0f14}.th-train .pz-pnl{background:#0a0f14;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #2b3a44,0 16px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}.th-train .pz-bn{background:#0a0f14}.th-train .pz-bn b{font:900 13px "Zen Kaku Gothic New";color:#ffb23e}.th-train .pz-bn .t{font:400 24px VT323;color:#ffb23e}.th-train .pz-toast b,.th-train .pz-pc>b{font:900 22px "Zen Kaku Gothic New";color:#eaf2f0}.th-train .pz-toast small.k{color:#8fc93a}.th-train .pz-toast::before,.th-train .pz-pc::before{content:"";display:block;height:6px;margin:-16px -16px 6px;background:#8fc93a;border-radius:12px 12px 0 0}.th-train .pz-pc::before{width:calc(100% + 36px);margin:-22px -18px 8px}.th-train .pz-ring span{font:400 26px VT323;color:#ffb23e}
